defs.def: connected with the job of sb who is in a position of authority 公务的；公职的；公事的

ex.s: Provincial government officials.
ex.t: 省政府官员。

ex.s: Seek assistance from UCLA officials.
ex.t: 向UCLA官员寻求帮助。

ex.s: The Government's sugar tax on soft drinks has brought in half as much money as Ministers first predicted it would generate, the first official data on the policy has shown.
ex.t: 据信今天的儿童和青少年摄入的糖分是推荐水平的三倍，使他们面临更高的患病风险。

ex.s: A government official.
ex.t: 一名政府官员。

ex.s: arranging meetings with government officials
ex.t: 安排与政府官员会面

ex.s: They are supportive of the city officials.
ex.t: 他们支持市政府官员。

ex.s: Gong Bao Chicken (also known as Kung Pao Chicken) was originally a family dish of Ding Baozhen, or Ding Gongbao, a high-ranking court official of the Qing Dynasty who helped reconstruct the Dujiangyan Irrigation System in Chengdu, Sichuan.
ex.t: 宫保鸡丁（又名Kung Pao Chicken）原本是丁宝桢（又名丁宫保）的家常菜，他是清朝的一位高级官员，曾帮助重建四川成都的都江堰水利工程。

defs.def: agreed to, said, done, etc. by sb who is in a position of authority 正式的；官方的；官方授权的

ex.s: Komodo National Park, officially recognized in 1980, is popular for ecotourism because of its unique biodiversity.
ex.t: 科莫多国家公园于1980年正式确立，因其独特的生物多样性而成为生态游的热门地。

ex.s: Students in New York City, meanwhile, have since 2016 been able to enjoy an official day's holiday for Chinese Spring Festival.
ex.t: 与此同时，自2016年以来，纽约市的学生可以在中国春节享受一天的官方假期。

ex.s: Note to teachers: Children’s Theatre has a study guide demonstrating how math and science can be taught through “Tom Sawyer.” For downloadable lessons, visit the official website of Children’s Theatre.
ex.t: 对教师的说明:儿童剧院有一份研究指南,说明如何通过“Tom Sawyer”教授数学和科学。 对于可下载的课程,请访问儿童剧院的官方网站。

ex.s: *Valid  passport          *Official work permit
ex.t: *有效护照          *正式工作许可

ex.s: If you forget to officially drop that course, a “F” (Fail) grade will be registered on your record at the end of the term.
ex.t: 如果你忘记正式退选那门课程，学期末你的成绩单上将记入一个“F”（不及格）成绩。

ex.s: If, at a later date, you wish to apply for a job or graduate school where an official copy of your UCLA record is required, it will be to your advantage to provide an impressive academic record.
ex.t: 如果在以后的日子里，你申请的工作或研究生院需要你的加州大学洛杉矶分校成绩单的正式副本，那么提供一份令人印象深刻的学业记录将对你有好处。

ex.s: After a three-year pilot period, the GPNP will be officially set up next year.
ex.t: 经过三年试点期，GPNP将于明年正式建立。

ex.s: Mr Titterton is chairman of the Omega Ensemble but has been the group’s official page turner for the past four years.
ex.t: 蒂特顿先生是Omega乐团的主席，但在过去四年里他一直是该乐团的官方翻谱员。

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即便这种计时方式在细节上很新颖，早期的农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来。例如在前古典时期的希腊，人们会通过把日期向前或向后调整来“修正”官方历法，以反映季节的变化。与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要。同样，我们正在开发的河流时间和其他计时系统或许也能唤起人们的环保意识。

ex.s: Official reports suggest that the number of households with three generations living together had risen from 325,000 in 2002 to 419,000 in 2013.
ex.t: 官方报告显示，三代同堂的家庭数量从2002年的325,000户增加到2013年的419,000户。

ex.s: The theft of the card has been officially proved.
ex.t: 卡被盗已有官方证明。

ex.s: But then we got an official letter and we were blown away.
ex.t: 但随后我们收到一封官方信函，惊呆了。

ex.s: So, for accurate and reliable predictions, it’s best to check an official, scientific report.
ex.t: 因此，为了准确可靠的预测，最好查看官方的科学报告。

ex.s: Even after Macquarie Island became an official nature reserve in the 1970s, the rabbits remained out of control.
ex.t: 即使在麦夸里岛于1970年代成为官方自然保护区之后，野兔仍然处于失控状态。

ex.s: Shirley Fitzgerald, the city’s official historian, told me that in its rush to modernity in the 1970s, Sydney swept aside much of its past, including many of its finest buildings.
ex.t: 悉尼官方历史学家Shirley Fitzgerald告诉我，在20世纪70年代急于现代化的过程中，悉尼抛弃了过去的很多东西，包括许多精美的建筑。

defs.def: that is told to the public but may not be true 公开的；公布的；据传报的

ex.s: For the biggest stadiums in the world, we have used data supplied by the World Atlas list so far, which ranks them by their stated permanent capacity, as well as updated information from official stadium websites.
ex.t: 对于世界上最大的体育场，我们目前使用了世界地图册提供的数据，该数据按公布的固定容量对它们排名，并参考了官方体育场网站的更新信息。

ex.s: Last week some city officials suggested the city might be interested in turning the old theater into a museum and public meeting place.
ex.t: 上周，一些市政官员表示，该市可能有兴趣把这座老剧院改造成博物馆和公共集会场所。

defs.def: formal and attended by people in authority 正式的；公务的；官方场合的

ex.s: A Poet Laureate is a person who has been officially chosen to write poetry for the country’s important occasions.
ex.t: 桂冠诗人是被正式选定为国家重要场合创作诗歌的人。

ex.s: Indeed official figures suggest the country has shrunk by 5% since 1993 and people in Russia live a shorter life now than those in 1961.
ex.t: 事实上，官方数据显示，该国自1993年以来已缩减了5%，俄罗斯人的寿命现在比1961年时更短。
